description:
Configure Blender for a VFX compositing pipeline using the BMW scene. 

1. Enable the following Render Passes in View Layer Properties:
   - Data: Z (Depth), Mist, Normal
   - Light: Diffuse -> Color, Glossy -> Direct, Ambient Occlusion

2. Configure Output Properties:
   - File Format: OpenEXR MultiLayer
   - Color Depth: Float (Full) / 32-bit

3. Render the scene (F12) and save the image to '/home/ga/BlenderProjects/bmw_passes.exr'.
4. Save the Blender project file to '/home/ga/BlenderProjects/bmw_vfx_setup.blend'.
